# Hotel Investment Today

> > Hotel Investment Today delivers institutional-grade intelligence on hotel investment, development, financial performance, and market trends across all segments and regions.

The publication covers hotel REITs, C-Corps, brand pipelines, development deals, financing strategies, and RevPAR analysis for industry professionals. Key coverage includes Marriott International, Hilton, IHG Hotels & Resorts, Host Hotels & Resorts, and major conferences like ALIS and Hunter.

## Key Topics

- Hotel Investment & Acquisitions
- Hotel Development & Pipelines
- RevPAR Analysis & Performance Metrics
- Hotel REITs (Host, Park, Hersha, Ashford, RLJ)
- Marriott International & Anthony Capuano
- Hilton & IHG Hotels & Resorts
- ALIS Conference
- Asia Pacific Recovery
- North America Markets (NYC, San Francisco, LA)
- Upper Upscale & Luxury Segments
- Hotel Financing & Lending
- Corporate Earnings (Q1-Q4 Results)
- Group Business & Special Events
- Market Trends & Forecasts
